title: The long form, if the shorthand is not comfortable yet
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload filter ((c) -> c.status == "active") map ((c) -> c.name)

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload filter ((c) -> c.status == "active") map ((c) -> c.name)

explanation.approach: Identical result. Naming the parameter is worth it once the lambdas nest and two `$`s would mean two different things.
